thread:
maya: Heads up from customer call  they wanted finer retention presets (1/7/30/180/365) in the UI and clearer copy about org overrides. They got confused by our single 'Retention' dropdown. cc @dina @sam

dina: Agree we should add presets. Current dropdown is freeform which is fine for power users but not for compliance teams. Propose: preset options + 'Custom (days)' at bottom with input.

sam: Good. Also the tooltip currently says 'defaults may apply' which is vague. Suggest: 'Effective retention: may be set at org or policy level. See docs.'

kevin: Small UX ask: when a preset is selected show a subtle badge near org name: "Effective retention: 30 days" so admins see immediately what applies. Keep it dismissible.

a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: presets should be buttons not links, with visible focus, and the custom input needs aria-label "Custom retention in days". If badge appears dynamically, use role="status" to announce it.

dina: Also flagged by legal: retention copy must mention whether exports include deleted records during the retention window. Add short help text: "Exports include events retained under the current retention policy." Link to docs.

sam: Backend FYI: infra currently enforces org override after UI validation, we need to surface when org override wins. The UI should show a small notice: "Org policy enforces 90 days; selection will be applied but not effective."

infra-bot: Note: API returns retention_source: [user, org, system] and retention_days. Recommend UI read retention_source and display "Selected" vs "Effective" states.

maya: Love that. UX flow: user selects preset -> UI shows "Selected: 30 days" and then if retention_source !== user show "Effective: 90 days (enforced at org level)". Add CTA "View org policy".

kevin: Region-order nit: when filtering audit logs by region, users expect org-default then recent then alphabetical. We had earlier proposals; customers prefer recent above alphabetical. Let's standardize to: org-default, recents, alphabetical.

a11y-bot: Keyboard behavior: region dropdown should keep open on ArrowRight/Left and move focus; Enter selects; Escape closes. Ensure screen reader sees live update when region filter applied. File bug #4622.

dina: I'll draft copy and small mock: presets UI, custom input, effective/selected banners, export help text about deleted records. Will include aria attributes and role=status for dynamic banners. ETA 48 hrs for PR.

sam: I'll add a backend check to expose retention_source in API and wire infra-bot suggestion. INFRA-1330 filed.

maya: Thanks! Outcome: add retention presets + custom input, clearer tooltip/copy about org overrides, dynamic "Selected/Effective" banners with role=status, export help text about deleted records, region ordering change to org-default/recents/alphabetic, and keyboard/a11y fixes. Closing after PR review. :thumbsup:
